name: Operations & Execution
question: Does the company reliably convert plans into shipped products, delivered services, and completed projects — on time, at quality, at promised cost?

signals.description: Launch/delivery track record vs announced dates — the backbone of this dimension (announcement-to-execution ledger, §4.4; ledger follow-through feeds in once tracking accrues)

recipe.query_template: {company} announced launch OR delivery dates versus actual ship dates

signals.description: Capex projects: on-time/on-budget coverage; news + filings extraction per project

recipe.query_template: {company} capex project on time OR over budget OR delayed
{company} gross margin OR operating margin trajectory

signals.description: Restructuring frequency ("transformation" every 18 months); news history search

Announcement-ledger follow-through rate: share of dated commitments delivered on time (§4.4). Fed by the forward-only ledger (WP6.1), NOT searched — this signal is injected at grading time from ledger.followThroughRate; the recipe is a placeholder and monitor_feed recipes are skipped by report-run research.

grade_anchors.A: Ships what it announces, roughly when announced; quality incidents rare and well-handled; margins behave as guided.
grade_anchors.C: Slippage common but disclosed; one live quality issue being managed credibly.
grade_anchors.F: Chronic delay pattern, repeated recalls/outages, or a "transformation program" treadmill masking execution failure.

false_signals.description: "Pilots" and "trials" with marquee names that never convert to production contracts. Pilot-announcement follow-through tracking at 6/12 months.

recipe.query_template: {company} pilot OR trial converted to production contract

false_signals.description: "One-time" charges appearing every year. Filings extraction of special-items frequency.
Shipped ≠ announced spec ("launch" that is a waitlist). Launch-claim vs availability coverage comparison.

recipe.query_template: {company} launch availability OR waitlist OR limited release

evidence_policy.notes: The announcement ledger (§4.4) is forward-only; follow-through rate feeds this dimension only after tracking has accrued (WP6.1).
